Question: asssalamu alaikum sir, sir whenever one of my friend tries to quit all his bad habits and tries to become a pious muslim and makes a strong decision the nent itself he mets with an incidence which avoids him to his goal for eg:he meets with an accident this happened for about 2 times so please give me a solution to his problem\ also i have very keen interest to see NABI (S.A.S) and SAHABA in my dreams but i never able to see them instead i get very bad dreams so please show me a way. Answer ID: 8882 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2278/1778=H/1429) (1) What do you mean by: strong decision? You should determine that in future you must not repeat the bad habits even in any condition. (2) Such dreams come if one discharges the due rights pertaining Allah and His creature and adopts piety and righteousness. However, seeing dreams are neither in one?s power nor one should be worried about it. Most important thing is that one follows sunnah in his life and strives to gain the pleasure of Allah, if he does not see such dreams throughout his life then there is no wrong in it even if he sees worst of dreams. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
